tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The desktop-facing base under the window chrome and behind glass in mockups. Never a text ground inside the window.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The list pane and settings background. Ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The detail pane, cards, inputs on focus, buttons. Ground for ink, ink-muted, vine, bloom, danger, warning.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: text fields at rest, search, segmented and toggle tracks, bar tracks. Ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Translucent overlay for hovered rows, ghost buttons and icon buttons. Layer it over any surface.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Translucent overlay for the pressed state of the same controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: pane dividers, card borders, button borders, row separators in settings cards. Decorative, so no contrast floor.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline for keycaps and the editor border on focus-less states.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Boundaries a control's state depends on (toggle-off track, toggle-off knob, checkbox). 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, glass and vine-soft (14:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, descriptions, placeholders, metadata, idle icons. 5.4:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and vine-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative glyphs only (empty-state mark). Never for information: it is about 3:1.

tokens.name: vine
tokens.usage: The one accent, chartreuse, as a FILL: primary button, toggle on, the cover. Never as text or a thin mark in light (1.3:1 on white); use vine-ink for those.

tokens.name: vine-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text, icons and marks: trigger prefixes, inline tags, the active sidebar icon, menu checks, usage bars, field focus edges. 4.6:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and vine-soft in light; 11:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: vine-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: vine-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows in the snippet list and backups list, hovered menu items, inline tag background. Ground for ink and vine-ink.

tokens.name: on-vine
tokens.usage: Text, icons and the toggle knob on a vine fill (13:1 in both themes). Dark in both themes: chartreuse always carries dark text.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Kudzu's flower. Marks favorites only: the star and the favorites badge. As text on surface-raised, surface and bloom-soft.

tokens.name: bloom-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the bloom badge.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons (an import that will overwrite, a trigger that clashes). On surface-raised and warning-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and inline notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors. On surface-raised and danger-soft; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and error notices.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of trigger chips and keycaps, so they read on surface, surface-raised and vine-soft alike. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Sidebar fill (84% opaque) under a backdrop blur of blur-glass. The fill, not the blur, carries contrast: ink everywhere, ink-muted only for counts and section labels.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, popovers, the toolbar cluster (92% opaque). Ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: glass-selected
tokens.usage: The active sidebar item: a solid pill sitting on the glass. Ground for ink.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: The 1px top highlight inside every glass layer (in CSS it is part of shadow-glass).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px outer edge of glass layers and the window.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. An alias of vine-ink, 4.6:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers on stat tiles. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Settings page titles and empty-state titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Pane titles (list header) and snippet name in the detail header.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Field labels in the editor, settings group titles, disclosure headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose a snippet to edit it.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles: snippet names in the list, sidebar items, settings row labels, buttons.

styles.name: content
styles.sample: Hi there, thanks for reaching out.
styles.usage: Snippet content in the editor and its preview: the user's own words get a reading size.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Descriptions under settings rows and fields; small buttons.

styles.name: trigger
styles.usage: Trigger chips and the trigger input. The signature face of the app (Geist Mono).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline tags in content, shell snippets, keycaps.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: File names, device IDs, version strings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside chips; gap between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; chip padding; list row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical 10, horizontal 12); button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; pane gutters; settings row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in the editor.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Detail pane padding; gap between settings groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of settings pages and empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separations only (empty-state offset).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline tags and keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Trigger chips, small buttons, segmented options, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, sidebar items, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the editor, menus, the toolbar cluster.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The window and full-height glass panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggles, badges, usage bars.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, the selected segment, toggle knobs.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The toolbar cluster and other small glass layers: the glass-stroke highlight plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The app window in mockups (macOS draws the real one).

size.note: Fixed dimensions of controls and panes.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented options inside a 28px track.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, toolbar icon buttons, search, sidebar items.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, select, trigger input.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Height of every pane's header row, aligned with the traffic lights.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width (glass).

tokens.name: size-list
tokens.usage: Snippet list / settings section list width.

tokens.name: size-detail-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the detail pane in the main window.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Sidebar and floating layers: backdrop-filter blur(28px) saturate(160%).
